Hi Sofia — thanks for sending the W-9. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Karthik (vendor ops) so we can align on the canonical fields and ERP routing.

For our vendor master we typically need the following fields (I'll paste this into a short intake form and share a Drive link):
- Legal entity name (as it should appear on POs and 1099s)
- Tax ID / EIN (exact formatting)
- Doing-business-as (DBA) names, if any
- Registered address (legal) and billing address (if different)
- Remit-to email and banking instructions (ACH/wiring)
- AP contact name, phone, email
- Preferred PO number prefix (helps with automated matching)
- Net terms requested and any early-pay discounts
- Country / VAT info (if applicable)

Can you confirm the legal name you want on the PO and attach a copy of the remittance CSV if you've got it. I'm attaching our vendor intake template to make this frictionless. If you can return it by EOD Wed Nov 4 we should be able to get the vendor record staged for Nov 8 creation — that gives AP a week to validate before your first PO.
